title: 初二长对话：课桌与老照片
source_notice: 初二普通期末公开卷具体结构已核；主卷三节5/5/5与参考键合写后10题标题冲突保留。正文地域未知、学校原版未认证；首5脚本完整而后段截断，原录音缺，不当gold。本稿为完整原创配套，未通过独立教研/学生/商用或生产验证。
timing_notice: 每段两遍，听前听后每题5秒；间隔和重播提示为本机编排
instruction: 听两段长对话，第一段回答第1—2题，第二段回答第3—5题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段两遍，听前、听后按每题5秒留时。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Nina, the front of our classroom is ready, but the desks are still in rows.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We need them in groups of four for tomorrow's quiz. The teacher asked us to move them after lunch.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will move them. Can you write the team names on these cards?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes. We are both in the Blue Team, aren't we?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes. I will put the blue card on the table nearest the door.

questions.rationale: A：班级课桌与老师要求支持；B：未涉及衣物；C：未涉及交通
A：男方负责移动；B：女方回答Yes接受写组名；C：没有让她选题

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: How was your visit to your grandfather, Adam?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Great. We found a box of photos from his first job. He repaired buses then.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Were there photos of the buses?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Yes, and of the people he worked with. I wanted to scan them, but the machine at home was broken.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: You can use the one in the school library.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good idea. He said I could borrow the photos until Friday. I will bring them in on Wednesday.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Ask him to write the names on a separate sheet. It will help you remember who everyone is.

questions.stem: What did Adam's grandfather do in his first job?
questions.rationale: A：未说火车；B：未说教学；C：明确repaired buses

questions.stem: Why could Adam not scan the photos at home?
questions.rationale: A：明确机器坏了；B：照片已经找到；C：祖父同意借至周五

questions.stem: When will Adam take the photos to school?
questions.rationale: A：是归还期限；B：明确bring them in on Wednesday；C：没有周一安排
